title: Kaaliya Mardhanam
desc: Geetha's murder is pinned on Ramu, the man she rejected, while the real culprits, Johnny, Rahim, Swami and Kannan, get off scot-free. However, the four spoilt brats fail to elude their karma.

title: Parampara
desc: When a gang of criminals kidnaps Johnny's son, he is left with no choice but to work with Lawrence, his estranged father, to save him.

title: Madraskaaran
desc: Sathya, an engineer-turned-farmer, lives peacefully in Kovilpatti with his family. His life is disrupted when he is attacked by henchmen sent by his enemy, Singam.

title: Lal Salam
desc: Nettoor Stephen, T K Antony and Sethulakshmi, three communist comrades, struggle to empower the labour class people. They get imprisoned when a landlord gets killed during an uprising.

title: Kaathil Oru Kinnaram
desc: Hari is dejected when he learns that he cannot marry his lover until her elder sister is married off first. Desperate, he enlists the help of a marriage broker to find a suitable match.

title: Oppam
